fn: Team Schedule: supervisors can now add, rename, regroup and remove people while editing (People button).
ds: Team Schedule editor (Geologist and Core Checkers): new People button in the editing bar. Type a code and name, pick a group (or leave Automatic), and Add person. The new person appears at once in the Paint list and in the availability list. You can also rename or regroup anyone, or remove them (their existing assignments stay and show as not in roster). Everything supports Undo and Revert all, and the roster goes into the exported packet. Same change in the standalone Team Schedule app (v214).
